plugins.name: flutter-dart-code-review
plugins.description: Flutter/Dart review checklist for what a general review walks past: accessibility, localization, widget idioms, rebuild and list performance, tests, dependencies. Reports findings by severity with a coverage record.

plugins.name: xcode-ios-pitfalls
plugins.description: Xcode silent failures: BUILD SUCCEEDED or green tests, then an entitlement quietly does nothing or a stale build is what runs. Signing, bundle identity, DerivedData, simulator state.

plugins.name: osyuu-skills
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic skills: release-assets ships the non-code deliverables (release notes, store screenshots, changelog, version bump); writing-standalone-skills drafts Matt Pocock-style skills whose product runs without any plugin or workflow artefacts.
